calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.net_amount AS sold, 0 AS refunded, (w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS no_dispatch
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, 0, r.refund_net, false
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, SUM(n.sold) sold, SUM(n.refunded) refunded, SUM(CASE WHEN n.no_dispatch THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_without_dispatch, COUNT(*) n
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS control_before, SUM(r.returns_net) AS control_returns, COUNT(*) AS days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, s.store_id, o.status, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-15' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND (s.store_id = 900 OR f.channel_code = 'WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
